correctness.rationale: Every shattered six-triple support yields six distinct private points and three unused points, leaving at most four residual points. A four-hit complement trace forces four residual coordinates and pairwise-intersecting residual pairs. The spanning intersecting pairs form a star. A complementary two-omission trace forces each of its three arm multiplicities to be at least two, hence exactly (2,2,2). Explicit trace witnesses prove sufficiency. The hub, arm, private and unused incidence degrees force unique counting, giving 21,621,600. Actual 286-center enumeration on 462 residual multigraph profiles and independent star-mask checks corroborate the proof; no finite extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: This is the complete classification of every maximum-cardinality shattered support at the natural sharp ambient order of a canonical disjointness graph. The top shattering-polynomial coefficient and unique symmetry orbit distinguish the full geometry and rarity of the extremizers beyond the old scalar VC dimension and one existence witness. The precise count is intrinsic to KG(13,3) and provides a reproducible benchmark for fine VC shattering spectra.
